status: Configurable illustrative bonded assembly; not measured mounting specifications

optics.dn_dT_convention: stress-free; photoelastic term uses ELASTIC strain, not total strain
optics.crystal_axes: lab z=[111], x=[1,-1,0], y=[1,1,-2], all normalized

sources.yag_baseline: Rupp et al., DOI 10.1007/s00340-022-07939-z; Stage 0 database
sources.copper: https://alloys.copper.org/alloy/C10100; rounded SI conversion of E=17000 ksi, G=6400 ksi, alpha=9.4e-6 /F, k=226 BTU/(h ft F), cp=0.092 BTU/(lb F)
sources.photoelastic: Bričkus and Dement'ev, DOI 10.3952/physics.v56i1.3272; commonly used cubic YAG host reference, not Ho-specific 2.09 um validation
sources.contact: h, stiffnesses, plate dimensions, mounting and coolant properties are assumptions requiring calibration

limitations: Finite compliant bonded interface, not unilateral opening/friction/delamination
Thermal conductance is prescribed independently of mechanical pressure
No solder plasticity, creep, residual stress from bonding cure or coating multilayer stress
Isotropic linear elasticity; polygonal-rim, linear-tetrahedron FEM requires mesh refinement
Frozen input heat field; full hot-mode/population/heat iteration is Stage 7
